area: the Claude skills and the profile avatars
summary: The /pilot-creator skill (new in this pull request) gains a scene section, a tool Tools/Build/pilot_art/scene.py and a third reader workflow, scene_read.js: two reader agents a run, about 220k tokens for four scenes. Eight avatars (Comet, Damsel, Dozer, Krush, Maestro, OPAL, Reaper, Slingshot) are re-cut from repainted busts; ids, guids and metas are unchanged.
why: Garrett's review of the avatars on 2026-11-11 (no crab hands, wings and fans grow from the back, a gradual jellyfish blend) and his ask for a second, realistic style of the same pilots. The scenes are four samples for him to choose from; nothing in the game imports them, and no profile code or prefab changed.
